# Tankrich — AI Consulting & Products

> Tankrich is an AI consulting practice run by Vivek Bothra, based in Melbourne, Australia. We help businesses and solopreneurs deploy practical AI solutions — from social media automation to intelligent dashboards and 24/7 AI assistants.

## About

- Founded and operated by Vivek Bothra
- Based in Melbourne, Australia
- Specializes in practical, production-ready AI solutions
- Clients include small businesses, solopreneurs, and growing companies
- Average time from concept to deployed product: 3 weeks

## Services

- Autonomous Social Media Management (X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook)
- Custom GPT Agents for Business Workflows
- AI-Driven Business Dashboards & Analytics
- Accelerated AI Product Development (Idea to MVP in 3 weeks)
- Secure Personal AI Assistants (WhatsApp, Telegram, Web)
- Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for Business Knowledge

## Live Products & Projects

- PureVeg.xyz — AI-powered global directory of pure vegetarian Indian restaurants (100+ cities)
- My Wealth Base (mywb.com.au) — ATO-compliant ESS/RSU/CGT tax calculator
- Internet Momentum Portfolio — Quantitative stock momentum tracker
- Market Top Signals — Global momentum dashboard for 14 stock market indexes
- Tankrich Signals — Live trading signals for Bitcoin, Gold, and Silver
- Fundamental Analysis Dashboard — Upload Excel for instant financial analysis
- Tankrich MFD — Mutual fund advisory platform

## Technology Stack

- AI/ML: GPT-4, Claude, RAG pipelines, custom agents
- Frontend: Next.js, Astro, React, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase, Node.js, Python
- Deployment: Vercel, Cloudflare, GitHub Pages
- Platforms: WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API
